summary_1line: Bhima kills the Rakshasa Jatasura, after which the Pandavas travel north toward Gandhamadana to await Arjuna and behold the mountain’s wondrous forests.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima lifts the stunned Rakshasa Jatasura high and smashes him violently upon the ground in the forest clearing.
Bhima and the Rakshasa uproot huge trees and strike each other while roaring like storm clouds in a devastated woodland.
The Pandavas stand in awe before the lush slopes of Mount Gandhamadana, surrounded by lotus lakes, peacocks, and flowering trees.
